description: A country residence in Langley, BC. Heavy timber gables and stone chimneys anchor a low-slung composition of wood and glass opening onto lawns, a curved pool and hot tub — West Coast craft carried into the Fraser Valley landscape.
note: Recovered from the studio's original website (listed as the Fahy Residence) via the Internet Archive; more photographs were on the original page but were not archived.

image.alt: Langley Residence — timber-and-stone house behind the curved pool and lawn
